nodes.name: Samuel Adeyemi
nodes.summary: Samuel Adeyemi leads the Water Workers Union. He initially supported the Harbor Vale Water Authority's plan to raise household water tariffs by 18 percent because it would protect maintenance jobs. In May, after the Authority's acting chief executive Nadia Okafor presented a revised plan that cut the tariff rise to 9 percent and included a discount for low-income households, Adeyemi turned against the proposal. He stated that the smaller tariff increase would force the Authority to cut 200 maintenance positions.
